summary: ansible-vault rekey changes the password on one or more encrypted files, and --new-vault-id can assign a new vault ID.
questions: How do I change the password on vault-encrypted files?
How do I rotate vault passwords?
Can I change the vault ID of encrypted files?

answer_card.title: Rekey encrypted files
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-vault rekey foo.yml bar.yml baz.yml
```

It prompts for the old and new password and can handle many files at once. To change the vault ID too:

```bash
ansible-vault rekey --vault-id preprod1@ppold --new-vault-id preprod2@prompt foo.yml bar.yml baz.yml
```
